{"code":"import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Calculate response rates by treatment arm
treatment_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute treatment effect
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

print(f"Treatment response rate: {treatment_response_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Control response rate: {control_response_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment effect (difference in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}")"}
